name: GoDaddy
description: GoDaddy lets agents check whether domain names are available and suggest names from keywords or a business description. It reads public domain data only and cannot buy domains or change DNS. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: Is northwind-bakery.com available? Check the .com, .co, and .shop names too.
Suggest ten short domain names for a mobile dog grooming business.
Which of these five names are still available: brightdesk, deskly, workbay, tasknest, plannr?

apps.name: GoDaddy
apps.description: Domain availability checks and name suggestions, over the GoDaddy MCP server with no sign-in.
